summary: Reviewed 49 units (342-390). 54 issues: 31 error, 23 minor. Main problems: brackets/parentheses and Latin-free rule broken in about 25 Hindi translations; glossary renderings not followed (hari 'green', dyumna/तेज, rādhas/दान, kavi, karma, kratu, svar, indu with Soma, vipra, ṛta, girvaṇas); dropped words (gāvaḥ in 349, vayaḥśayam and mahāntam in 353, vocative in 351, brahma in 390, naryam in 371); placeholder dots in 353; unsupported additions (367 'coming', 377 'that wins', 380 '(women)', 385 'कहकर'). Units 357, 358, 374, 378, 384 need no change. No regrouping suggested (353 and 379 keep their printed line division). Manual: 351 split rayiṃ|vo (keep or regroup as rayivaḥ), 376 dyāvaḥ sense unresolved, 364 vaspatim and 353 are low-confidence and stay so.
